svg.title: How the Minecraft Family Server works
svg.desc: A home Minecraft Bedrock server for PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, phones and PCs. Consoles look up a Featured Server; a DNS redirect on your computer sends them to BedrockConnect, which shows a server list; picking Family Server moves them to the Bedrock server. Setup: install Docker Desktop, run ./start.sh, set each console's DNS to your computer's IP.
